monitoring.test_type: Explicitly labelled synthetic CPU 81/80 threshold; real chat.postMessage transport; no actual CPU incident claimed

seed: Fresh separate local-identity PostgreSQL database; DatabaseSeeder then LocalDemoDataSeeder twice; original safety guards retained
browser: Production Chrome login page; HTTP 200, headers present, no page errors/CSP violations in this smoke check
limitations: Human review must be recorded by another member before merge; user owns merge.

CSP allows inline bootstrap/style for static Next pages and eval for the existing Filament/Alpine runtime; it is a compatibility baseline, not a strict nonce policy.
No staging/production deployment or load-capacity claim.
